sections.title: Harden postgres_cluster driver against SQL injection via parameterized queries and Identifier quoting
sections.rationale: All driver hunks replace string-formatted SQL with psycopg2 parameterized queries and SQL/Identifier composition, eliminating injection of db_name/db_username/db_pwd into CREATE/GRANT/DROP/SELECT statements.

sections.title: Mark bad-username tests as xfail now that injection-hardened driver accepts them
sections.rationale: Both test hunks add @pytest.mark.xfail to tests that previously relied on SQL syntax errors from unquoted usernames, which the new Identifier/parameterized driver no longer produces.
